value.rationale: Two canonical random-tree observables—offspring of a birth-labeled vertex and global leaf count—switch dependence sign in a nontrivial sharp finite-size transition n=7, with unique age boundary and explicit asymptotic critical fraction 0.284668. A root-only covariance gives neither this self-leaf competition nor a qualitative sign phase diagram. It informs age-stratified inference and exposes cancellation hidden by aggregate degree-count summaries.
